{{Quote|Essentially the same response as the others, Lord Vader. Almost impossible to translate, but I believe he's lamenting the death of his people.|A Protocol Droid, to Darth Vader|<ref name="LC1" />}}
'''Atoan''' was the language spoken by [[Atoan|natives]] of the planet [[Atoa/Legends|Atoa]]. When [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces arrived on Atoa around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], they found that the unintelligible natives did not speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], which was an oddity as the nearby planet of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] had been involved in the Galactic Republic for thousands of years.<ref name="LC1" />

One exception was the [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Saro]], who said she had recently gained the ability to speak Basic by killing a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] and consuming his tongue.<ref name="LC2">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 2|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 2]]</ref>
